reviews.decision_reason: The selection step treats the supplied corpus rows as demand-bearing without visible market-demand support such as observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes. Because unsupported candidates can pass through unchanged, this is the likely behavioral source of later unsupported priorities.

The normalized output retains the selected records and existing record identifiers without visible contradiction in the supplied package. The package does not show a normalization defect independent of the suspect upstream selection.

The provenance assembly output preserves the expected handoff records and ranks them deterministically from the normalized needs. No local assembly fault is visible in the supplied semantic evidence; any bad recommendation appears inherited from unsupported selected inputs.
